title: Anonymous responsive newsletter unique clicks flat

change.control: Desktop-style nonresponsive newsletter requiring pinch and zoom.
change.variant: Use responsive text and layout, easier navigation and approximately five to six additional swipes to the end.

significance.reported: No statistically significant difference in unique clickers reported.

quote: There was no statistically significant difference in the number of people who clicked
notes: Unique clicks were inconclusive, not proven equivalent. Total clicks fell while reading increased; the source discusses metric-dependent conclusions. Do not count these as separate experiments.
